# Synthetic Non-Copyrighted Audio Test Fixtures (`tests/fixtures/audio/`)

All audio files in this directory are **100% original, algorithmically synthesized, non-copyrighted (CC0 / Public Domain)** fixtures generated directly from [`poc/python/audiophile_poc/compose.py`](../../../poc/python/audiophile_poc/compose.py).

No copyrighted music or third-party recordings are ever committed to this repository.

## Included Fixtures

- **`original_nocturne_24_96.flac`** — 14-second original physical-modeling acoustic duet (Karplus-Strong waveguide nylon-string guitar with cedar soundboard body resonances + plucked upright double bass + FFT-convolved stereo recital room), synthesized in IEEE 754 `float64`, TPDF-dithered to **24-bit / 96 kHz** stereo lossless FLAC, normalized to **`-12 dBFS`** peak for amp-safe playback testing.
